description: Validate a public https website address and return a prefilled order link for its owner. Use it when the user wants their own website checked for bugs, security problems or UX issues. Does not order, charge or contact the site; the owner confirms authorisation and pays on the linked page.

goal.description: Main goal: conversion = Improve the main conversion path (signup, trial, purchase); clarity = Make the product easier to understand on first visit; mobile = Fix the mobile experience; onboarding = Improve signup or onboarding; general = General UX/UI review of the main journey.

url.description: Public https:// address of the website to audit (the user's own site).

name: prepare_website_audit_order
title: Prepare an audit order link for the site owner
